observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: D-054 central feed bootstrap/publication/last-good are exercised using self-authored TEST ONLY data. AT22 remains blocked on resolver document delivery (w3-contracts-r5, then nodes/agent), metrics listener, real member URL flow and remaining file/raw-usage/backup retention coverage. Commercial feed approval remains a business decision.

observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: B9: contract permits threat_feed.attribution=null and creating/activating it succeeds, but a referencing dns_profile returns 422 VALIDATION_FAILED because internal/policies/store.go:buildAndValidateDNSProfileTx passes blank AttributionNotes to internal/dnspolicy/sources.go:ListSource.ValidateMetadata. Owner policies/DNS; accept the contract-null attribution or request a contract revision. Workaround below uses explicit TEST ONLY attribution.

observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: Node resolver-document delivery remains blocked on w3-contracts-r5 then nodes/agent follow-ups. Central feed last-good and document publication do not establish resolver enforcement or a full AT22 privacy pass.
